pages.title: Connection
pages.text: Power cables attach to block surfaces. Run a cable from a generator to buffers and energy consumers.$(br2)Check the mounted surface and connection direction, and provide supporting blocks when routing around corners.

pages.title: Network operation
pages.text: Available power is shared among connected consumers. Generate enough power to meet their combined demand.$(br2)Every chunk along a route must be loaded for transfer. If distant equipment stops, check both the power supply and the route.
